headline: Alabama becomes 45th state to allow statewide ridesharing services
snippet: Ivey signed, effective July 1 2018. Expanded access to urban and rural communities.

headline: Ride-sharing bill approved in the House, but it will need a second vote in the Senate
snippet: Approved 97-3. Transfers Uber/Lyft regulation from cities to state level.

headline: Governor, lawmakers to unveil bipartisan bid to create uniform rules for Uber, Lyft
snippet: Alabama one of only 6 states without statewide ride-sharing rules.
